item.title: The Confidence Myth: Why You Don’t Need to Feel Ready to Win - Inspiring Rare Birds
item.description: What is Imposter Syndrome and how can you tame it? First identified in the late 1970s, Imposter Syndrome is more than a fleeting lack of confidence. It is a persistent belief that you are not as capable as others perceive you to be, despite clear evidence of your success. It shows up as self-doubt, fear of being “found out” and an instinct to downplay your achievements. In short, it has a talent for turning amazing moments into anxious ones. Here's how to tame it.

item.description: At Inspiring Rare Birds, we are committed to advancing economic equality in the workplace. item.title: Clarity. Confidence. Mindset. - Inspiring Rare Birds
item.description: This topic wasn’t chosen randomly. It was deliberately selected for a recent Inspiring Rare Birds roundtable, where four experienced women from across industries were invited to share their lived experience and hard-earned wisdom. Why? Because across Inspiring Rare Birds programs, women consistently cite the same three needs. You can't just flick a switch, so how do we get clarity, confidence and the right mindset?
